fieldValues.title: The essay home's words are help records: a container essay-home in the bundled help repository, concept and ui records, shared with the essay container
fieldValues.decision_question: Where do the home page's words live: in the Svelte component, in a website-package site repository rendered by the site shell, or in the bundled help repository as records?
fieldValues.context: The owner, 2026-11-03 (vignette 24c38533-b35a-470a-bd78-42eca4bc0258): 'The help and site content should all be managed via srs.' Decision 9441693e and unit semanticops.com#49 (rulings R1, R2, R7; remedy 44a6f76d affirmed): every editor carries its help as data in help/ (package com.semanticops.help, type ui-feature with placement ui or concept), one container per editor whose entry order is the display order, components only name a feature by data-feature, a contract test fails on drift, and a paired agent reads the same records through ui_help. The help loader (src/lib/help/help.ts helpFor) selects a container by name, so a container named after a screen rather than an editor needs no code. ui_help returns nothing while no repository is loaded, so the home page itself cannot be read by an agent; records shared into the essay container are. The site shell (decision 6c455725, srs-web#680) renders a website-package page, but the generic block shell that would render a page outside a site repository is not built (srs-web#694). Precedent consulted: 9441693e, R1, R2, R7 (semanticops.com#49), 44a6f76d, 6c455725, ADR-027 (components carry tokens only; no words in components), ADR-048 rule 'once, in the right place'.
fieldValues.alternatives_considered:
A. Words in the Svelte component. Leads to: fastest to write; breaks the owner's rule and 9441693e; an agent cannot read them; drift is invisible.
B. A website-package site repository for the home, rendered by the site shell. Leads to: the home becomes a real SRS site, editable in the site editor, the right long-term shape for site content; needs the generic block shell (srs-web#694) and a second bundled repository before the first visitor can be sent a link.
C (chosen). A container essay-home in help/, with concept records (who is in charge; where your essay lives) and ui records (start; try an example), shell.connect-ai shared in, and the two concept records also members of the essay container so a paired agent reads them once an essay is open; the component renders items and names features only. Leads to: edited in the editor or by the srs CLI, drift-checked by the existing contract test, the same words for people and agents; the page can hold only title, summary, explanation per item, which is enough for a home and not for a magazine.
fieldValues.decision_statement: The essay home's words are ui-feature records in the bundled help repository, in a container named essay-home whose entry order is the page order; concept records that explain the editor are also members of the essay container so a paired agent reads them through ui_help; the EssayHome component names its features by data-feature and holds no words; the existing help contract test guards the drift. The home page itself is outside an agent's reach until a repository is open, and that limit is stated in the ADR.
fieldValues.rationale: C over A because the words must be managed in SRS and readable by the writer's agent; A gives neither. C over B because B needs the generic block shell that does not exist and a second bundled repository, which puts the owner's URL weeks away, while C ships on what semanticops.com#49 already built; B stays the direction for site content and is the revisit trigger. C costs no new type, loader or check: a container named after a screen is already what helpFor selects by.
fieldValues.revisit_when: When the site shell can render a generic block page from a bundled site repository (srs-web#694 or its successor): then the home moves to a site repository and this decision is superseded. Or when the home needs an item that is not title, summary and explanation (an image, a table of examples that is not a list of links).
fieldValues.next_steps: srs-web PR 1 of the essay-home unit: the essay-home container and records, the shell.save correction (GitHub is not a first-save target), EssayHome.svelte with a styleguide specimen, README note that a help container may be named after a screen.
